title: Repository hygiene: audit .gitignore
description: Audit the .gitignore file to ensure it correctly ignores generated files and build artifacts for the stack actually used (Node.js/Vite/TypeScript/PostgreSQL backend/Docker). The current .gitignore ignores tasks/ and prd.md which prevents ticket tracking files from being versioned. Remove inappropriate ignores and ensure generated artifacts (node_modules/, dist/, coverage/, test-results/, qa-artifacts/, *.log, etc.) are properly ignored.
acceptanceCriteria: Review current .gitignore for incorrect or missing entries
Remove ignores that block versioning of source-tracked files (e.g., tasks/, prd.md if they should be tracked)
Ensure Node.js artifacts (node_modules/, package-lock.json changes, dist/, .vite/) are ignored
Ensure Python/Playwright artifacts (test-results/, qa-artifacts/, playwright-report/, coverage/) are ignored
Ensure Docker/backend artifacts are ignored appropriately
Ensure OS-generated files (.DS_Store, Thumbs.db, *.log, *.tmp) are ignored
Verify `git status` shows no unintended untracked generated files after changes
